episodes.title: Legendary, Level One
episodes.time: Same opening retreat, immediately after first launcher use and crossing. No exact clock printed; no eligible quiet recovery or XP award yet.
episodes.location: Beyond the marked junction, moving north along the near wall toward the bend/service door. Kip and Owen carry Jory; Tessa ahead; rearguard between litter and live hunter.
roster: Dane Mercer (not yet named to Kip)
injuries: Kip: open superficial palm-length forearm cut from broken stone, bleeding toward cuff; shoulder soreness from arrival; no healing yet.
Jory: splinted lower-leg fracture persists; earlier shin skin cut already closed.
Hunter: bolt embedded in exposed foreleg, still alive and following.
objects: One launcher bolt discharged; empty channel observed; bolt remains in hunter.
Jory remains on litter carried by Kip/Owen.
Tessa retains short spear; Dane retains sword in right hand.
Kip retains work clothing, keys and wallet; phone remains on Earth in van, not recovered.

Kip: Knows own legendary Dungeon Sovereign class, level one, initial forty Mana and current thirty.
Knows Dominion Sight inspection and Override ten-Mana/ten-metre/five-second existing-fixture limit; Claim Room remains unused.
Knows names/roles Tessa scout, Owen field healer, Jory porter; rearguard name not learned yet.
Heard Cinderwell; saw Quickstep as rapid physical movement; has no full companion class descriptions.
Tessa/Owen/Dane: Saw Kip help carry and trigger one launcher after warning allies; private class, rarity, level and Mana not disclosed.
Kip has not yet introduced his name or Earth biography aloud.
reader: Saw immediate private legendary class panel, choice to carry Jory, one legal paid power use, live wounded pursuer and no final escape.

episodes.ending: All five remain alive and in retreat beyond the junction. Kip and Owen carry Jory toward the service-door bend while the rearguard delays the living wounded hunter; no refuge or escape is secured.

episodes.title: Twenty Mana Left
episodes.time: Same opening retreat, then protected wound treatment for twenty seconds and several minutes of active patient repositioning/room checks. No completed sitting/lying quiet recovery minute established.
episodes.location: All five inside the old service chamber, approximately twelve by ten metres. Entry door closed and barred; second service passage obstructed by fallen stone. Intact squat anchor near the middle of the floor, not yet inspected or claimed.
injuries: Kip: superficial forearm cut closed by one complete Mend; residual tenderness and shoulder soreness remain. No blood replacement or general healing.
Jory: splinted lower-leg fracture persists; previously closed shin cut remains closed.
Hunter: still wounded by the spent bolt, alive when driven back; scraping withdraws outside the barred door. No kill established.
objects: Jory rests on his litter inside the chamber; splint retained and repositioned carefully.
Tessa retrieves/retains her short spear after using both hands at the door; Dane retains sword in right hand. No new weapon for Kip.
The first launcher remains empty; its single spent bolt was not recovered.
Fire vent used through one full five-second Override; control ended normally. No ownership or permanent suppression established.
Kip retains keys and wallet. His phone remains charging in the van on Earth.

Kip: Knows Dane Mercer is expedition leader and has a class; observed eight-second Bulwark reduce but not eliminate impacts.
Has demonstrated a second legal Override on a seven-metre visible fire vent with an ordinary pivot and safe firing arc.
Knows Mend takes twenty seconds and twenty Mana and cannot set Jory's broken bone. No full companion descriptions/private values learned.
Knows his own level two, XP zero of two hundred, Mana twenty of forty-five; leveling increased maximum without refilling current Mana or removing fatigue.
Knows Tessa, Owen and Dane received the same one-hundred XP reward after their linked retreat/rescue completed. No reward for Jory established.
Knows the room has a floor anchor; Claim Room remains unread/unselected. Does not yet know its cost, obligations or result.
Tessa/Owen/Dane: Kip openly confirms he has a class and can turn/fire the vent for five seconds. He does not disclose class name, legendary rarity or private Mana maximum.
Kip has not yet introduced his own name or Earth biography aloud.
The four active contributors confirm the same retreat award; their different levels need not rise together.
reader: Noah is Kip's nineteen-year-old younger brother with his own life at home; this is Kip's private worry, not information shared with companions.
The hunter withdrew audibly, not a confirmed kill; the room is temporary physical shelter with an untested anchor.

episodes.ending: All five are physically sheltered in the barred service chamber, with the onward passage obstructed. Kip has twenty Mana and considers inspecting Claim Room before committing; no room claimed or new skill granted.
